body.objective: Add a finite, proof-producing local-to-global calculus so Forge and Conflux can distinguish a local field/operator identity from a globally defined object with compatible patching, topology, boundaries and charges. The current programme repeatedly crosses this boundary in magnetic bundles, black-hole horizon/exterior charts, local anomalies and causal support, but the compatibility data is not yet one reusable mathematical type.
body.stop_condition: Define finite covers and incidence nerves; presheaves, sheaves and cosheaves of exact vector spaces/complexes; restriction/corestriction maps; sections with checked compatibility; Cech chain/cochain complexes, cohomology and hypercohomology to a declared finite page; descent data, cocycles and obstruction classes; relative/boundary versions; and comparison maps between Cech and a supplied global complex. Demonstrate on a magnetic U(1) bundle over S2, a two-chart black-hole horizon/exterior carrier and a local anomaly cocycle: reconstruct one global object from compatible local data, return a nonzero obstruction for a mutated transition function, and distinguish a locally exact cocycle from a globally nontrivial class. Export cover, transitions, descent witnesses and unresolved refinement dependence to Conflux.
body.forbid: no local formula treated as globally defined without transition checks; no good-cover theorem assumed when its hypotheses are undeclared; no Cech result promoted to derived/global cohomology without a comparison condition; no topology erased during chart canonicalization; no sampled patch overlap called a proof; no physics-specific spacetime cover hard-coded in lib/math
notes: Priority B. This is the generic bridge from local symbolic algebra to global charges, bundles and boundary sectors.
Compose with bundle-characteristic-topology, categorical diagrams, bicomplexes and support/wavefront types.
Start with finite covers and finite complexes; unsupported infinite or non-paracompact settings return UNDECIDED.
